title: .desktop launchers are not executed when Desktop Folder View uses "Files linked to the current activity"
line: Double-clicking an app launcher on the desktop now starts the app when the desktop shows the activity's linked files or a custom folder, instead of asking whether to open or launch it.
explanation: FolderModel::run() skipped KIO's 'open or launch?' question for .desktop files only when the item's URL was at the root of desktop:/. When the desktop containment shows another location (Files linked to the current activity, or a custom folder), every launcher double-click asked how to open the file instead of starting the app. The change also skips the question whenever the model belongs to the desktop containment's root view (usedByContainment). KIO still shows its 'untrusted program' warning for launchers without the executable bit, and Folder View widgets keep asking as before.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: run launchers on the desktop whatever its location

Launchers on the desktop only ran directly when it showed desktop:/, so
with a custom folder or the activity's linked files a double-click asked
whether to open or launch them. Run them directly in the containment.

BUG: 523024

patches.diff:
From 52a41264a7fd8a111fcf60f090759996f0ada104 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 01:42:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: run launchers on the desktop whatever
 its location

Launchers on the desktop only ran directly when it showed desktop:/, so
with a custom folder or the activity's linked files a double-click asked
whether to open or launch them. Run them directly in the containment.

BUG: 523024
---
 containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp | 12 +++++++-----
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
index 678bae687c..489594ff21 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
+++ b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
@@ -854,11 +854,13 @@ void FolderModel::run(int row)
 
     auto job = new KIO::OpenUrlJob(url);
     job->setUiDelegate(KIO::createDefaultJobUiDelegate(KJobUiDelegate::AutoHandlingEnabled, nullptr));
-    // On desktop:/ we want to be able to run .desktop files right away,
-    // otherwise ask for security reasons. We also don't use the targetUrl()
-    // from above since we don't want the resolved /home/foo/Desktop URL.
-    job->setShowOpenOrExecuteDialog(item.url().scheme() != QLatin1String("desktop") || item.url().adjusted(QUrl::RemoveFilename).path() != QLatin1String("/")
-                                    || !item.isDesktopFile());
+    // On the desktop (whatever folder it shows) and on desktop:/ we want to be
+    // able to run .desktop files right away, otherwise ask for security reasons.
+    // We also don't use the targetUrl() from above since we don't want the
+    // resolved /home/foo/Desktop URL.
+    const bool onDesktop =
+        m_usedByContainment || (item.url().scheme() == QLatin1String("desktop") && item.url().adjusted(QUrl::RemoveFilename).path() == QLatin1String("/"));
+    job->setShowOpenOrExecuteDialog(!onDesktop || !item.isDesktopFile());
     job->setRunExecutables(true);
     job->start();
 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Desktop set to 'Files linked to the current activity', executable launcher linked to the activity: double-click shows 'What do you wish to do with this file?'
Same double-click with the fix: the launcher starts Konsole directly
Desktop set to a custom folder containing the launcher: the same open-or-launch question
Same with the fix: Konsole starts directly
Security kept: a launcher without the executable bit in the custom folder still gets KIO's 'This will start the program' warning

reviews.text: Clean and well-scoped fix in `FolderModel::run()` that includes `m_usedByContainment` in the desktop check so `.desktop` launchers on the desktop containment run directly whether the desktop shows `desktop:/`, `activities:/current/`, or a custom folder. Non-`.desktop` executables and Folder View widgets outside `desktop:/` retain the open-or-execute prompt, and KIO's untrusted-program warning is preserved for non-executable launchers as verified in the screenshots.

The cause is right: FolderModel::run() skipped the open-or-execute question only for items at the root of desktop:/. Extending that to the desktop containment's root view (usedByContainment) makes launchers behave the same whatever location the desktop shows, which is what the reporter, Akseli and Nate asked for. Security is unchanged: KIO still shows its untrusted-program warning for launchers without +x (after-3 shows it). The shots cover both the activity-linked and custom-folder cases. Folder View widgets keep asking. That fits the report's 'Desktop Folder View' wording, and the notes point it out for the maintainer.
